description: Explainable multi-UE, multi-PDU intent and slice operations dashboard.

panels.title: Healthy slices
panels.description: All PCF/SMF/UPF pods Ready in each selected slice

panels.title: Active UEs
panels.description: Unique UEs with at least one active PDU

panels.title: Active PDU sessions
panels.description: Counts sessions, not UEs; one UE can have several PDUs

panels.title: Selected slice
panels.description: Latest explainable policy decision

panels.title: Intent flow state
panels.description: Make-before-break state machine

panels.title: Slice suitability by UE and candidate slice
panels.description: Current per-intent ranking. Historical CLI snapshots are excluded.

panels.title: Current UE → PDU → slice mapping
panels.description: Live OAI TUNs only; this table is independent from old intent snapshots.

panels.title: Passive throughput
panels.description: Instrumented flow telemetry plus passive TUN counter deltas.

panels.title: RTT
panels.description: No data until application instrumentation or an explicitly enabled active probe is present.

panels.title: Jitter
panels.description: No synthetic value is inferred from throughput.

panels.title: Packet loss
panels.description: No data without an instrumented application or active probe.

panels.title: Open5GS active PDU contexts
panels.description: 5GC-side session evidence from AMF/SMF/UPF exporter

panels.title: Connected UE inventory
panels.description: Network registration view; IMSI and UE address are exporter labels

panels.title: UE and PDU counts per slice
panels.description: UE count and PDU count are separate because multi-PDU makes them unequal

panels.title: Score components by UE and slice
panels.description: Auditable inputs: requirement fit, QoS headroom, live health/load and intent affinity.

panels.title: Slice CPU and memory load
panels.description: Live Kubernetes usage divided by configured resource limits.

panels.title: Configured vs enforced vs measured throughput
panels.description: Configured policy is not a guarantee. Enforced is the live UPF qdisc; benchmark is measured evidence.

panels.title: PDU session capacity usage
panels.description: Active 5GC PDU contexts divided by the per-slice policy limit.

panels.title: Slice capability profile
panels.description: Declared QoS/AMBR/ARP plus measured baseline. A zero benchmark means the saturation test is not yet valid.

panels.title: Current service SLA assessment
panels.description: Live validation result. DEGRADED remains usable but is not presented as an SLA guarantee.

panels.title: SLA dimensions
panels.description: 1 means the measured dimension meets the intent threshold; 0 means it does not.

panels.title: UPF QoS enforcement
panels.description: Live verification of the expected downlink TBF after UPF restarts.

panels.title: Effective capacity used by Intent Engine
panels.description: Minimum credible configured/enforced/benchmark value, labelled with evidence status.

panels.title: Active intent and reference inventory
panels.description: Reference count prevents one UE/service from releasing a PDU still used by another intent.

panels.title: Active application flows
panels.description: Observe-first lifecycle: application flow exists before its intent and target PDU.

panels.title: Application telemetry freshness
panels.description: Intent decisions wait for a complete, fresh observation window.

panels.title: 5G lab root disk usage
panels.description: Orange at 70%; red at 80%. The host disk guard performs safe cleanup at 75%.

title: ANSA – UE Multi-PDU Intent & Slice Operations
